description_for_human: News radars, open sensors and checks for AI agents. Read-only and free.
description_for_model: Orb Studio gives read-only, free JSON for AI agents: news radars, open market and weather sensors, a freshness map of its own sensors (/api/v1/freshness), a free word-rule check of any claim or headline (/api/v1/check-claim?claim=) and a signed 30-minute brief (/api/v1/brief?topic=news or crypto, verify at /api/v1/agents/witness/<id>). Checks are word rules, not AI, and measure how a claim is built and carried, not whether it is true. Indicator, not financial advice.
